backup.settingsDescription: Keep a copy of this workspace somewhere safe, on this computer or with a service you already use. A copy can be sealed with a passphrase before it leaves, so whoever holds it cannot read it.
backup.whereDescription: One destination at a time. A folder on a disk you can unplug is the only one that keeps working with nothing switched on.
backup.destinationBody: You can change this at any time. Copies already made stay where they are.
backup.destinationNoneHint: Choose a folder or a service before taking a copy.
backup.destinationFolderHint: Including an external disk or a network drive.
backup.destinationServiceHint: Put copies in a folder in your {} account.
backup.destinationCloudHint: Store copies with the AppFlowy Cloud workspace you are signed in to.
backup.enabledHint: When this is off, copies are only taken when you ask for one.
backup.scheduleHint: A copy is skipped rather than queued if AppFlowy is busy when it falls due.
backup.contentsDescription: Caches are never copied — they hold nothing that cannot simply be fetched again.
backup.partWorkspaceHint: Every page, table, folder and setting you have written.
backup.partAttachmentsHint: Everything brought into the workspace, plus saved web pages. This is usually most of the size.
backup.partPageVersionsHint: Earlier states of pages, if you are keeping them.
backup.partPreferencesHint: Appearance, shortcuts and the like, so a restored workspace feels familiar.
backup.maximumFileHint: One very large video should not make every copy enormous. Anything left out is named in the copy's own record.
backup.compressionDescription: Squeezing costs time and saves room. Disk on this computer is cheap and time is not; room in somebody else's cloud is the other way round — so the two are set apart.
backup.localCompressionHint: Used for a copy on this computer, whether that is the destination or a copy kept beside a remote one.
backup.remoteCompressionHint: Used for the copy that crosses your connection and takes up your quota.
backup.compressionTwice: These two settings differ, so each copy is gathered twice — once for here and once for the service.
backup.sealingDescription: A sealed copy is encrypted on this computer before it goes anywhere, with AES-256-GCM and a key derived from your passphrase.
backup.encryptHint: The service holding the copy cannot read it. Neither can anyone else, including us.
backup.sealUnlocked: The passphrase has been entered, so copies can be taken.
backup.sealLocked: A copy on a schedule cannot ask for the passphrase. Enter it once to let scheduled copies run.
backup.sealBody: This is not your workspace passphrase. It seals copies before they leave this computer, and it is the only way to open one again.
backup.unlockBody: Held for this session so copies can be taken without asking again.
backup.changePassphraseBody: Copies already made keep the passphrase they were sealed with. Only copies taken from now on use the new one.
backup.removePassphraseBody: Copies taken from now on go out unsealed. Copies already made stay sealed and still need their own passphrase.
backup.removePassphraseWarning: An unsealed copy can be read by anyone who has it.
backup.passphraseHintPlaceholder: Shown beside the passphrase field. Never the passphrase itself.
backup.passphraseWarning: The passphrase is never stored anywhere unless you ask this computer to remember it. Lose it and no copy sealed with it can ever be opened.
backup.passphraseTooShort: A passphrase needs at least {} characters.
backup.passphraseWrong: That passphrase does not open this.
backup.passphraseCouldNotSet: The passphrase could not be set.
backup.rememberPassphraseHint: Sealed by Windows for your account, so scheduled copies keep running after a restart.
backup.rememberPassphraseSession: This computer cannot seal a stored passphrase, so it is only held until AppFlowy closes.
backup.openCopyBody: This copy is sealed. Enter the passphrase it was sealed with — which may not be the one you are using now.
backup.keepDescription: The newest copy is never swept, whatever these say.
backup.keepLocalCopy: Also keep a copy on this computer
backup.keepLocalCopyHint: A copy you still have when the service cannot be reached.
backup.localCopiesHint: Older ones are removed once there are more than this.
backup.remoteCopiesHint: Older ones are removed once there are more than this.
backup.nowDescription: Copies are gathered, squeezed and sealed on a thread of their own, so you can carry on working.
backup.neverRun: No copy has been taken yet.
backup.lastFailed: The copy on {} did not finish: {}
backup.copiesDescription: What is at the destination now. Restoring never writes over the workspace you have open — it unpacks into a folder you choose.
backup.copiesDescriptionCloud: AppFlowy Cloud cannot be asked what a folder holds, so the list is stored beside the copies. Sign in on another computer and it comes back with nothing carried over.
backup.copiesNone: There are no copies at the destination yet.

pageVersions.settingsRoomTitle: How much room they may take

pageVersions.settingsLinkedHint: Off by default: it reaches out over your network every time a version is taken, for content that already has a history where it lives. With it off, a version records only how the collection is bound and what it says about itself. The files themselves are never copied.
pageVersions.linkedNotRead: Linked to a service. Its contents were not read — turn that on in Settings ▸ Version history.
pageVersions.linkedEmpty: The service held nothing at the time.
pageVersions.settingsOnOpen: Keep a copy when something is opened
pageVersions.settingsOnOpenHint: Remembers what it was before this session. Nothing is stored when it has not changed.
pageVersions.settingsOnClose: Keep a copy when something is closed
pageVersions.settingsOnCloseHint: This is the one that catches a file or a table, which change without the page itself saying anything.
pageVersions.settingsIntervalHint: A copy on a clock, for work that never pauses long enough to settle.
pageVersions.settingsPageBytesHint: How much one object's history may take before its oldest copies are swept.
pageVersions.settingsTotalBytesHint: How much the whole history may take across the workspace.
pageVersions.settingsFileBytesHint: A file bigger than this keeps a history of its name and settings, but not of its contents.
pageVersions.settingsSweeping: Applying the rules to everything stored…
pageVersions.settingsAutomaticHint: Keep a copy of a page once the writing has settled. Versions you save by name are kept whatever this says.
pageVersions.settingsKeepAllHint: Nothing is ever swept away. Turn this on only if you have the room for it.
pageVersions.settingsCopiesHint: How many automatic copies of one page survive. The newest is always kept.
pageVersions.settingsDaysHint: How old an automatic copy may get before it is swept away.
pageVersions.settingsDaysForever: As long as there is room
pageVersions.settingsQuietHint: How still the writing must be before a copy is taken.
pageVersions.settingsSpacingHint: Stops a long writing session filling the list with near-identical states.
pageVersions.settingsClearBody: Every remembered state of every page is thrown away. The pages themselves are untouched.
